chapter: Becoming a musician: ukulele, clarinet and the Boozaire Kings
title: Naming the Boozaire Kings
summary: Danny organized a band and named it the Boozaire Kings after the Creole word for a good time.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Now, Herman Henderson was an aristocratic little kid, see. He was there, and... But his people didn't want him hustling or none of that. They had aspired for him to be a little college kid, and his mother was a midwife and his father worked as...he was a helluva mechanic with a big machine company, a machine design... And his grandmother was a midwife. And he was high-class. But he... He had a little thing with him, but that's what his parents did.

So I said, "Well, man, we're gonna make it. Let's organize a band." So we called the band the Boozaire Kings. Because what you say... Them people down there are having a ball or party, you say "they're having a boozaire(?) down there." Now, that's a "boozain", that's a good time in Creole patois, in Cajun...
So "boozaire" is patois for "a good time."
Yes. Now, "baza"(?) is a humbug. So you had the "boozaire" on that (?), and it turned into a "baza." You know a bazaar? A regular bazaar where all the...
Man, it's a "ba-za." "Man, they had a boozaire(?) last night, and man, a cat got drunk and turned
that place into a baza(?)! A humbug!

So I named the group the Boozaire(?) Kings. So Ervin Butler, sure enough, comes and get us. We started right at the corner of the house. We played out on the side of the street by the bar, by the door. We played ..[SINGS REFRAIN] Charlie Costain(?) sang "Apple pie ..[INAUDIBLE].." [SYNCOPATING] Man, all the people come out the barroom to see this music, because they're used to itinerant... Then they say, "You'all can come on in here." So they send us some money. So we made about fifty cents. Well, then Butler got the hat, he passed the hat -- he's hustling hard. We go to the next bar, kept on going.
